_comment: Ground-truth corpus for PortWatch Pro. Each target is a labeled reference host whose exposure is known in advance. 'expected' is the analyst's ground truth; the harness compares scan output against it and reports precision/recall, vuln-flag TP/FP, and score-vs-expert calibration.

targets.name: clean-host
targets.description: A hardened host: only DNS and an RDP port, no scripts, no vulns.

targets.name: vpn-gateway
targets.description: A perimeter gateway exposing FTP, SMTP and MongoDB.
targets.expert_note: Unauthenticated services on a perimeter host.

targets.name: ci-cd-pipeline
targets.description: A build server exposing FTP and MongoDB.
targets.expert_note: Unauthenticated DB on a build host.

targets.name: public-kiosk
targets.description: A public kiosk exposing Redis and MongoDB.
targets.expert_note: Data stores on a public-facing host.

targets.name: dev-workstation
targets.description: A developer workstation with an exposed database.
targets.expert_note: DB exposure on an internal host.

targets.name: backup-server
targets.description: A backup server exposing SMTP, POP3, RDP and web proxies.

targets.name: iot-camera
targets.description: An IoT camera with a confirmed web RCE and exposed data store.
targets.expert_note: Confirmed CVE plus exposed MongoDB on an untrusted device.

targets.name: staging-box
targets.description: A staging host with many exposed services and databases.
targets.expert_note: Broad exposure on a staging host.

targets.name: mail-server
targets.description: A mail server exposing databases on the mail path.
targets.expert_note: Data stores reachable on a mail host.

targets.name: vulnerable-web
targets.description: A web application host with many exposed services and data stores.
targets.expert_note: Broad exposure on a public web host.

targets.name: db-exposed
targets.description: A host with a confirmed web RCE and many exposed services.
targets.expert_note: Confirmed CVE plus broad service exposure.

targets.name: legacy-win
targets.description: A legacy Windows host: FTP, Telnet, POP3, HTTPS, MSSQL, RDP, Redis.
targets.expert_note: Classic vulnerable Windows exposure, no script evidence.
